sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've heard there's trouble brewing at the chemical plant these days. Looters are crawling all over the place, carrying off anything they can get their hands on. And I know every inch of that place. I worked security there myself for half a year, before TerraGroup showed up. None of this sits right with me. Those bandits need to be taught a lesson. Make them forget the road to that factory, if only for a little while."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Well done! There's no shortage of scum in Tarkov, and others will come soon enough. But next time, they'll think twice before helping themselves to what isn't theirs."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 6 PMCs anywhere on Factory
